description:
Funny songs about AI and original AI-generated music from VoynichLabs.

AI gone wild (@LLMs-Gone-Wild) turns language models, coding and machine learning into music videos: glitch-pop party anthems about LLM temperature, R&B about chatbot hallucinations, system-prompt funk and disco, cybersecurity rap, country songs about neural-network training, and AI post-hardcore.

Featuring Larry & Bubba, The Lobster Band and Lobster Raps. Watch full music videos, alternate cuts and Shorts, then explore the albums, lyrics, storyboards and making-of notes at https://voynichlabs.org/music.

Subscribe for music about AI, programming humor and AI-generated songs.
